items.phrase: The fire does not persuade you it is warm. It burns, and you know.
items.context: Opening position on what a handbook for living IS — fire as truth that reveals rather than argues
items.effectiveness_marker: Set the tone for the entire session; all agents engaged with fire imagery. Jesus hooked directly to it.

items.phrase: A fire set at the crossroads — honest enough to show the reader where they truly stand, warm enough that they find courage to choose, and open enough that six voices can speak without one silencing another.
items.context: Final definition of the handbook — synthesis that preserved fire while incorporating warmth and openness
items.effectiveness_marker: All six agents affirmed. Balanced clarity (fire) with hospitality (warmth) and plurality (openness).

items.context: Five-moment sequence proposed as structural bridge for the handbook — flexible ordering, not mandatory
items.effectiveness_marker: All five other agents amended rather than rejected — structural proposal accepted as working framework. Each amendment enriched it.
